evidence_semantics.basis: Actual root-observed terminal statuses, substantive parsed outputs and negative controls; model reports and packet fields alone do not certify results.
evidence_semantics.correlation: Luna implementation/source reports are same-lineage support; root independently executed gates, inspected source/raw bytes and attacked input/output/CLI boundaries.
evidence_semantics.template_fallback: No standard packet template/graph validator is provided in this repo. JSON parsing, exact default-deny changed-path checks and actual digest dereferencing are the fallback, not substantive proof by themselves.
evidence_semantics.decay_trigger: Changes to production/spec/helper/reconciliation inputs, capture artifacts, pins, settings or fixture profiles; missing temporary references also remove reproducibility.
evidence_semantics.refresh: Rerun affected DEBUG/RELEASE and helper/raw/negative gates as required. New runtime or full advanced admission requires fresh stock-to-library and library-to-stock full-part whole-object AND independent path witnesses.
evidence_semantics.failure_policy: Keep persisted versions2/3 rejected; reopen dependent claims on failed or stale evidence.
